test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

They have adopted multiple strategies to enhance learning outcomes in rural schools.

options.text: Multiple strategies have been adopted to enhance learning outcomes in rural schools.
Multiple strategies are being adopted by them for better learning outcomes.
Multiple strategies were adopted by them.
Multiple strategies are adopted by them to improve learning.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They have adopted multiple strategies to enhance learning outcomes in rural schools."
 
• This sentence is in the **Present Perfect** tense. The rule for conversion is: *Object + has/have + been + V3 (Past Participle) + (by + Subject).*
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "Multiple strategies" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "have adopted" to "have been adopted."
 
• The rest of the sentence ("to enhance learning outcomes in rural schools") follows the verb. Note that "by them" is optional and often omitted in passive voice when the agent is general or implied.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Multiple strategies have been adopted to enhance learning outcomes in rural schools."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"Multiple strategies are being adopted..." – Incorrect because "are being adopted" is the Present Continuous passive form.
 
• **Option 3: **"Multiple strategies were adopted..." – Incorrect because "were adopted" is the Past Simple passive form.
 
• **Option 4: **"Multiple strategies are adopted..." – Incorrect because "are adopted" is the Present Simple passive form.
